messages:
nina: noticed a batch of snapshot restores failing in eu-west-1 with KMS AccessDenied. Seems tied to recent infra role rename.
omar: Which key? customer CMK or our cross-account replication key?
nina: Customer CMKs for three tenants (tenant-12, tenant-33, tenant-88). Error shows principal arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/backup_uploader_oldname denied.
lucy: We renamed the uploader role to backup_uploader_v2 last week as part of RBAC cleanup. Did we update KMS key policies/grants?
infra: deploy-bot: Rolename change applied to iam-service. No automated KMS grant reconciliation triggered.
secops-bot: Incident logged: ENC-DR-2026-04. Severity: high for affected tenants.
omar: That explains it. KMS key policy still references the old role ARN. Need to either: update key policies, or create grants for the new role. Key policy edits are sensitive.
nina: Quick mitigation: create temporary KMS grants for backup_uploader_v2 with Encrypt/Decrypt for the specific CMKs. Grants can be short TTL. Any objections?
lucy: OK but remember encryption context must match. Our restore path includes context {"tenant_id": "<id>", "snapshot_id": "<id>"}. Grants won't bypass context mismatch.
omar: Right — if encryption context was set at encrypt time and our copy/restore uses same context then decrypt will succeed. Check logs for context mismatch field.
nina: I sampled the CloudTrail event for one failed decrypt: encryptionContext omitted in Decrypt call. That likely came from the restore worker which got a cached token with old role.
infra: We rolled out a worker scaling change that used service account mapping. Might have lost context propagation for out-of-band workers.
lucy: For immediate triage: 1) create ephemeral grants for backup_uploader_v2 on affected CMKs with a 6hr TTL. 2) Restart restore workers ensuring context is passed. 3) Run a targeted test restore per tenant.
omar: Also add a SIEM alert: any DecryptDenied on /snapshots/* and principal contains backup_uploader. Tagging owners.
nina: Post-mortem actions: - Add an automated reconciliation job that syncs key policies/grants on role rename. - Add CI test that simulates role ARN drift. - Add an RBAC change checklist that includes KMS updates.
l ucy: small nit: don't edit customer CMK key policies without approval. Use grants where possible. Documented in KMS-runbook.
infra: I'll provision the ephemeral grants now and post the grant IDs.
nina: For audit: we need a list of all snapshots attempted since the rename and show which restores failed. That goes to compliance.
secops-bot: Update: mitigations applied. Grants created for 3 CMKs (grant ids posted in ticket). Monitoring for failed decrypts enabled.
omar: Once restores complete, schedule key-policy remediation with customer ops and ask for approval to update if they want permanent role in policy.
lucy: Good. Let's keep the window tight and avoid broad key edits.
nina: thanks team, will attach CloudTrail snippets and a short runbook for the oncall to the incident.
infra: noted. Will follow up with the reconciliation PR template.
secops-bot: Incident resolved: pending verification. Last check: 1735550180.
